subject: Compliance ops handoff — scheduling SOC 2 / DPA / pen test walkthrough

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance ops handoff — scheduling SOC 2 / DPA / pen test walkthrough

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the quick note on the intake form. We’re ready to run a joint walkthrough that covers: SOC 2 scope, DPA redlines you flagged, and the pen test logistics (scoping, credentials, and timelines). To make this efficient, can you confirm which of the following windows work for your team (times in UTC):

- Option A: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 — 15:00–16:00 UTC
- Option B: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 — 10:00–11:00 UTC

If neither works, send two slots that work for your security folks and procurement. Also please confirm who from Creston will join (security lead + procurement contact). I’ve attached a short compliance overview and a draft calendar invite to speed scheduling.

Pre-reqs:
- A point of contact for pen test scope (name + email)
- Any time zone constraints or blackout windows next two weeks

Goal for the call: agree on scope + deliverables, agree a pen-test window, and hand off evidence collection owners for SOC 2 controls.

Thanks — happy to be flexible on times.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com
redwood.com
